description: This file is the entry point widget for a Flutter e-commerce application, setting up the main scaffold with app bar, bottom navigation, and handling page transitions between key screens like Home, Discover, Cart, Profile, etc.

classes.name: EntryPoint
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the main entry point for the app, managing bottom navigation and page display.

classes.name: _EntryPointState
classes.description: State class for EntryPoint, holding navigation state and building the scaffold with app bar and bottom navigation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including app bar, body with page transition, and bottom navigation bar.

methods.name: svgIcon
methods.description: Custom helper method to create an SvgPicture widget with given source and optional color, used for icons in app bar and bottom navigation.
